buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery

time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses SPECIFICATION DOCUMENT 1. Scope of Supply:- The bidder shall supply, transport and deliver rota tional moulded 4-Layer Thermally Insulated LLDPE water storage tanks of capac ities specified in the document at the designated consignee location in Leh, Lad akh. The tanks shall be complete with standard lids/covers, fittings and accesso ries required for their intended use. S N Items A/U Qty o (i) LLDPE 04 layered water storage tank 200 Ltr Ca Nos 44 p (ii) LLDPE 04 layered water storage tank 500 Ltr Ca Nos 53 p (iii) LLDPE 04 layered water storage tank 1000 Ltr C Nos 32 ap 2. TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS i) The water storage tanks shall be manufactured from 100% Virgin Food- Grade Linear Low-Density Polyethylene (LLDPE) using a seamless Rotati onal Moulding process in strict accordance with IS 12701:1996 (with latest amendments) and certified under IS 9845 / IS 10146 for safe drinking water st orage. Engineered specifically for extreme sub-zero temperatures and high-altit ude radiation in Ladakh, the tanks must feature a 4-layer wall construction: an outer heavy-duty LLDPE layer with UV-20 grade stabilization / carbon blac k to resist solar oxidation; an intermediate high-density Polyurethane (PU) / P olyethylene foam core (30-35 kg/cum) providing thermal insulation; an opaq ue light-barrier layer to completely eliminate algae growth; and a smooth, anti- bacterial virgin white inner contact layer for hygiene and ease of cleaning. All ta nks must comply with IS 12701 dimensional, weight, and wall-thickness parame ters, featuring high cold-impact strength, threaded/lockable lids with air vents, pre-moulded flat inlet/outlet bosses, and a valid embossed ISI Mark along with the manufacturer’s CML license details. ii) The bidder/OEM shall supply items holding a valid Bureau of Indian Standa rds (BIS) License (IS 12701:1996). Each tank delivered to the site must clearly b ear the embossed ISI Mark, manufacturer's license (CML) number, net capacity, and date of manufacture.

iii) Each tank shall be supplied with a proper fitting and durable lid/cover. The lid shall be adequately secured and shall prevent entry of dust, insects and forei gn matter into the tank. iv) The tank shall have suitable provisions for inlet, outlet and overflow conne ctions. Necessary threaded/socket fittings shall be provided as required for pro per installation. v) The tank shall carry a minimum 03 year warranty against manufacturing d efects, leakage, cracking and failure attributable to defective material or workm anship. vi) For the guidance of bidders, materials meeting above mentioned specifica tions shall be typically manufactured by established brands such as Sintex (Pur e/Thermoshield Series), Supreme (Siltank Thermoshield), Vectus (4-Layer Foam Series), Plasto (Insulated Series), or equivalent. The mention of brand names above is purely illustrative to establish the requisit e quality benchmark. vii) If a bidder/OEM proposes to supply any brand other than those indicated a bove, the bidder/manufacturer must prove sustained product performance unde r high-altitude conditions. Specifically, the offered brand must have been succe ssfully supplied at least two (2) separate times in different financial years within the last five (5) financial years to the same Central/State Government D epartment, Defense/Paramilitary Force (e.g., Indian Army, BRO, MES, ITBP), UT Administration, or PSU operating in a high-altitude/sub-zero region (such as Lad akh, J&K, Himachal Pradesh, Uttrakhand, Sikkim, or Arunachal Pradesh). viii) CRAC, Completion Certificates or Performance Reports issued by the client department for both executed orders, confirming that the supplied tanks were d elivered successfully and are performing satisfactorily under sub-zero condition s without structural failure. Bids proposing alternate/other brands that lack proof of repeat supply to the sa me government department in different financial years in a high-altitude area s hall be deemed technically non-responsive and rejected. 3. TERMS & CONDITIONS i) Delivery Condition:- a) Consignee Unit: - Consignee Unit is 501 SS&TC (GREF), Spituk, Leh. b) Delivery location: - Stores are required to be delivered at 501 SS&TC (GRE F), Spituk, Leh within 30 days from the date of placing of GeM contract. ii) Document Required:- The under mentioned documents should be submi tted by sellers in T-Bid:-

(a) Experience in supply of similar nature of goods/items during any of t he last three years. If a bidder proposes to supply any brand other t han those indicated in Para 2.(c), the bidder/manufacturer must pro ve sustained product performance under high-altitude conditions. S pecifically, the offered brand must have been successfully supplied at least two (2) separate times in different financial years wit hin the last five (5) financial years. (b) ATC Certificate duly accepted all terms and condition duly mentionin g specific bid number. (c) OEM Authorisation certificate with valid date and authorised signatur e. (d) Past performance @50%. (e) Seller Turnover for last three years duly verified by CA. (f) EMD Rs. 29940/-. (g) Compliance certificate as per para 144 (XI) of GFR 2017. (h) The bidder/OEM shall submit a Warranty certificate for 10 years of the ite ms mentioned in Para 1. (j) Bidder/OEM shall submit BIS/ISI Certification: Valid Bureau of Indi an Standards (BIS) License Certificate (IS 12701:1996) issued in the nam e of the original manufacturer, along with the CML (Certification Marks Lic ense) number. (l) The bidder/OEM shall submit Material Safety & Food-Grade Certi fication: Test certificates from an NABL-accredited laboratory confirming compliance of the inner LLDPE layer with IS 9845 / IS 10146 for overall migration limits (drinking water safety). (m) The bidder/OEM shall submit Thermal & Insulation Test Reports: Certified NABL lab report confirming the foam core density (30-35 kg/cum )), thermal insulation effectiveness, and UV-20 grade stabilization of th e outer layer. (n) The bidder/OEM shall submit product datasheet of the items with pr

oper specifications of each item. (o) The successful bidder shall submit ePBG@3% for 36 months and the hard copy of the same shall reach this office within 10 days from placing t he supply order. Note: In case of any conflict between generic and ATC, ATC shall prevail. iii) Option Clause:- The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered upto 50 % at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity by upto 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. Bidders are bound to accept the orders accordingly. iv) Cancellation of Bid:- Competent Authority will have the right to cancel t he bid at any stage of procurement process including after opening of financial bid and Reverse Auction without assigning any reason to seller. No representati on will be entertained in this regards. v) Advance Sample: Not Applicable. vi) Inspection of Stores:- The supplied stores to be checked by a Technical Board of Officer detailed by competent authority. vii) Rejected Stores :- All rejected stores are liable to be back loaded by sell er within seven days from consignee location at own risk and cost in case of sto res not accepted by TBOO. viii) Liquidated Damages :- If the Stores are not supplied within the stipulate d period/time limit as specified, a penalty of 0.50% per week or not exceeding 1 0% of the total cost of the GeM order will be levied for late supply. ix) Sellers Past Performance Criteria In 753 BRTF:- If any seller has aw arded GeM contract by HQ 753 BRTF in earlier and found pending for completi on or supply store partially even lapse of delivery date or GeM contract cancell ed due to non supply of stores, such seller not to be considered to be qualify in T-Bid evaluation. No representation in this regards will be entertained. x) Payment terms & Condition:- Payment will be released as per GeM Terms
& Conditions. xi) Payment Authority:- PCDA (BR), New Delhi. Sd/-xx- SEO .
